contexts: · Cash: Based on preliminary, unaudited estimates, Plug’s net cash usage for Q3 2026 was approximately $28 million, marking continued improvement for the year. Plug ended Q3 2026 with approximately $134 million in cash and cash equivalents (excluding restricted cash). The Company did not raise any proceeds through its at-the-market (ATM) offering program or generate proceeds from other equity or debt capital raises during the quarter. Hence, this net cash usage for the third quarter reflects overall operating results and fundamental improvement, which the Company believes supports its forecast for continued improvement in Q4 2026.
